comment.body:
<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"a86bed3aa065fbfdc70f0994bd73eb73394f3143cd94e571e3d7cda1dca6961a"} -->
The reported defect was not reproduced

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — The reported video ad and the leftover banner background do not appear on ootrandomizer.com when the reporter's own filter lists are applied:⁠ the Raptive/AdThrive loader is blocked, the ad slots render empty at zero size, and full-page vision found neither annotated target. Recommend closing as not reproduced; the only ad-recovery path on the page (html-load.com) is already neutralized because Base filter redirects the detection probe to noopjs.

## Policy rationale

The reported ads are served by a third-party ad network (Raptive/AdThrive), not the site's own advertising, so the first-party-ads policy does not apply. The report is not a paywall and not a German anti-adblock wall, and the page shows no anti-adblock message, so none of the no-rule policy clauses closes it. No policy clause blocks rule generation; the close is recommended on non-reproduction of the reported defect on the loaded page with the reporter's filter set.

## Artifacts

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/43660752570

<sub>Automated analysis against filters at `04e0f73`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.</sub>

Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — fluxpayroll.ai shows a first-party cookie-consent bar (fixed, full-width, z-index 9999) on its Polish pages, served by the site's own Next.js/MUI bundle with no third-party CMP request to block. The domain-scoped cosmetic rule fluxpayroll.ai#⁠#⁠body ⁠> div.MuiPaper-elevation6 hides that one element and was verified in the reporter filter profile with the page intact and no residue. ## Rule `fluxpayroll.ai##body > div.MuiPaper-elevation6` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale The reported symptom is a cookie-consent notice, not first-party advertising, a paywall, or a German anti-adblock wall, so none of the instruction's close rules applies. The page shows no anti-adblock gate and the captured requests contain no detector script, so no anti-adblock exemption or hand-off applies. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/04e0f73b214ddc9d9c59ded9a5934878059d9f39/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt) At the end of the file. ## Screenshots
